ac_results.ac: D1 Prefilter: no tracked name or no keyword -> no gateway call; a match -> exactly one call

ac_results.ac: D8 Anchor rule property over 10,000 random refit chains; straddle -> mid; spread = wider
ac_results.evidence: All 226,981 (anchor, current, mid) grid triples give |p-mid| <= |anchor-mid| and keep p between mid and anchor. defects.description: anchored_p fails open on non-finite input. anchored_p(nan, 0.9, 0.5) returns 0.9 (the unbounded current), and anchored_p(0.55, nan, 0.5) returns nan. Both comparisons are False with NaN, so the else branch returns p_current. A chain of refits cannot cause this, because the anchor never moves in Loop A, so it cannot ratchet edge. But a buggy or missing anchor value at wiring time would silently bypass the bound.
defects.fix_hint: At the top of anchored_p, return mid if any input is not finite: `if not all(map(math.isfinite, (p_anchor, p_current, mid)))`. Do the same in anchored_spread, or let it raise.

defects.description: Family verdicts are never cleared for games that are never pulled, and stale ones persist. A non-material 'sky' verdict from 40h earlier makes an unrelated later material 'bbc' item read 'injury, bbc; sources disagree' (probe 8). The pull itself is correct, so the impact is a misleading flag plus unbounded growth of self.verdicts.
defects.fix_hint: Clear verdicts[k] when a new pull starts on a game with no active pull, or key verdicts by news window. Optional.

defects.description: Test gap: nothing tests out-of-order news arrival, where a later-received item carries an older timestamp. Replacing `max(self.news_ms.get(k, t), t)` with `t` survives the whole test file. The code is correct today (auditor probe 6).
defects.fix_hint: Add one assert: news at T0+10h, then news stamped T0+2h, then an observation at T0+5h returns None.

The two modules import only re, unicodedata, advisor.contracts, numpy and scipy (grep for socket, http, urllib, requests, environ, subprocess and vendor names finds nothing). No three-flag guard is needed because there is no authenticated path. LLM: only through an injected Gateway; tests use FakeGateway; no vendor call. Network: the autouse socket guard is present and proven, and no test needs the network. In Loop A, c stays in [0,1], the candidate c is at most the point estimate, and c_in_force rejects out-of-range or NaN values for 0.3. Look-ahead: walk_forward trains only on rows resolved before t_split and drops straddling clusters from test. Owned paths: WP4-D files are advisor/sentinel.py, learning/loop_a.py and tests/phase4/test_sentinel_loop_a.py; no other file is attributable to WP4-D. advisor/contracts.py (14:21:48), trader/contracts.py (12:11) and common.py (09-30) predate WP4-D's files (14:38-14:41). learning/__init__.py and advisor/__init__.py were created by the orchestrator at 14:21:50. No secrets (grep is clean; the test url is example.invalid). Reports: the dispatch gives WP4-D no report path and none was written, so 'How to reproduce' does not apply. Minimal code: 112 + 127 lines, no speculative abstractions, one test file. notes:
All code-level criteria D1 to D10 pass. D11 is [ops] (calendar time, the human token, role 13), so the verdict is PASS_WITH_OPERATIONAL_PENDING. I found three minor defects and no blocker or major ones.

Mutation check: I made 15 mutants of scratch copies, since deleted. The tests caught 14. The survivor is the out-of-order news-time max, which is a test gap; the code is correct.

The builder's judgement calls are acceptable:
- refit_step scores raw current against candidate and never uses the anchor; the bound is applied at use time by anchored_p.
- c_candidate uses min(lower quantile, point). This equals the lower quantile on all observed data and is cautious otherwise.
- Rows exactly at t_split go to the test set; D9 still holds.

The refit gate accepts a tiny improvement when it is perfectly consistent across clusters (se close to 0). That is correct significance-test behaviour, not a defect.
